sql: SELECT firstName, lastName, deathYear - birthYear FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID IN ('PCHA', 'NHL') GROUP BY T1.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.lgID) = 2

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T2.year, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.playerID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = (SELECT playerID FROM Goalies GROUP BY playerID ORDER BY COUNT(playerID) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T2.year

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID AND T2.year = T3.year WHERE T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T1.birthCountry = 'Canada' AND T1.pos = 'G'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameGiven, T3.name, T2.year FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID AND T2.year = T3.year WHERE T1.playerID IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.nameGiven, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL) / SUM(T2.GP) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID = 'aebisda01' GROUP BY T1.nameGiven
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.coachID) FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.w > 30 AND T2.birthCountry = 'USA'
SELECT firstName FROM Master WHERE hofID IS NOT NULL AND shootCatch IS NULL
SELECT W FROM Goalies WHERE playerID = 'vanbijo01' AND year = 1990
SELECT T1.w FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.year = 1933 AND T2.award = 'Second Team All-Star'

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2002 AND T2.GA > 150 ORDER BY T1.birthYear DESC, T1.birthMon DESC, T1.birthDay DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT GP FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'broadpu01' AND year = 1922
SELECT BenchMinor, name FROM Teams ORDER BY T DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(PPG) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(PPC) FROM Teams GROUP BY tmID ORDER BY SUM(L) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE firstNHL = '2011' AND shootCatch IS NULL
